title: Choose the visual world for the money app
question: Second hand, steered toward calm and household. Kakeibo stays available as your favorite.

options.label: Nordic Forecast
options.thesis: Money read like a calm weather forecast: the next 30 days of your balance, with bills falling like rain below it.
options.viewport: Side rail; a 30-day cash forecast strip leads (balance line, bill bars below); budgets and review queue under it.
options.risk: The forecast strip is new; it must stay readable for household members who never saw a meteogram.

raised.raise: On the phone, the review queue shows one transaction per screen and snaps to the next.
Long lists carry guide words: the date range in view is always named at the top.
One reserved color marks only the item you are acting on; nothing else may use it.
Each screen shows the next decision first: what needs you now, then everything else.

options.label: Kakeibo Household Ledger
options.thesis: The monthly money ritual: plan, record, reflect, on calm pages that celebrate what was saved.
options.viewport: This month as a spread: income and savings at top, budgets as ruled rows, a reflection line, review list beside it.
options.risk: Familiar warm-paper look; most calm finance apps land close to this.

options.label: Envelope System
options.thesis: Each budget is a labeled envelope that empties as you spend and refills each month.
options.viewport: Budgets as a grid of envelopes with fill levels; net worth and review queue in a calm header band.
options.risk: Familiar: YNAB and many budget apps use the envelope idea.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: Near-white printed sheet, hairline rules, one grotesque; each account and budget is a registered plate.
options.viewport: Net worth as a large plate, budgets and bills in a 4-up hairline row.
options.case: Very clean and calm; reads more like a printed annual than a friendly household tool.
options.risk: Can feel cool and gallery-like rather than encouraging.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: One item fills the screen; snap to the next.
options.case: Wrong energy for a calm money tool.
options.kept: Phone review queue: one transaction per screen, snap to next.

options.label: Lexicon Page
options.thesis: Fixed measure, guide words, color only in plates.
options.kept: Guide words naming the date range in view.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Fixed terrain colors, one purple course on top.
options.case: Nobody here reads maps to manage money.
options.kept: One reserved color for the item in action.

options.label: Airport Wayfinding
options.thesis: Yellow bands show the next decision.
options.case: Loud yellow fights a calm brief.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Black and white barcode data fields.
options.case: Cold and strobing; the opposite of calm.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern finance dashboard in the style of Monarch and Copilot, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, greeting, net worth chart card, budget cards, recent transactions.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every finance app by design.
